Q1: How should this fix-up reach `ai/issue-7072`, given that its body has no branch line?
Choices:
A) A person edits this issue body to add a line `Target branch: \`ai/issue-7072\`` and then posts `/reclarify`. Implement then branches from `ai/issue-7072` and opens its PR against that branch. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Close this fix-up with no code change. Land the allowlist entry directly on PR #7076 (head `ai/issue-7072`), either by hand or through its review/autofix loop.
C) Implement on `main` anyway. This contradicts "do not add the exception on main" and fails the audit test, because the workflow file is missing on `main`.
**Note:** C is incompatible with every Q2 option, since none of them can pass CI on `main`.
Q2: How should `ISSUE_7248_TARGET_BRANCH_UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP` apply to the new allowlist entry on `ai/issue-7072`?
Choices:
A) No env-var gate on the test entry. Add `pr6576-shard-followup.yml` with its rationale unconditionally on `ai/issue-7072`. The placeholder stays an unread, unset operator-step marker, and `main` is unchanged. This keeps the audit test and CI green. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add the entry only when the env var is set. CI on `ai/issue-7072` stays red (`Unclassified checkout@v5 workflows`) until someone sets it, which contradicts "require the audit test and CI to pass".
C) Only record the placeholder in an `agents.d/` fragment, with no test change anywhere. The operator then makes the `ai/issue-7072` edit by hand.
